english: Start begins automatic rerolling in that slot. Stop stops that slot.
translation: Start porneste rerularea automata in acel slot. Stop opreste acel slot.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start all resumes only inactive slots. Redundant Start all / Stop all shows a message.
translation: Porneste tot reia doar sloturile inactive. Un Porneste tot / Opreste tot inutil afiseaza un mesaj.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Change bonuses requires stopping this slot first. Clicking while it runs only shows a message. Confirming makes one change, even if the targets already match.
translation: Schimbarea bonusurilor cere oprirea acestui slot mai intai. Un clic in timpul rularii doar afiseaza un mesaj. Confirmarea face o schimbare, chiar daca tintele se potrivesc deja.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start/Stop ignores double-clicks for 0.5 s. Start waits for the previous result; a blocking popup names the bonus and reason.
translation: Start/Stop ignora dublu-clicurile timp de 0,5 s. Start asteapta rezultatul anterior; un pop-up de blocare arata bonusul si motivul.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 5. One speed for all three slots
translation: 5. O viteza pentru toate cele trei sloturi
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The slider sets the gap between the requests of all active slots: 0.05-1 s.
translation: Glisorul seteaza pauza dintre cererile tuturor sloturilor active: 0,05-1 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The step is 0.05 s. The default is 0.05 s; the chosen speed is remembered.
translation: Pasul este 0,05 s. Implicit este 0,05 s; viteza aleasa este retinuta.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: With 3 items at 0.1 s each item changes about every 0.3 s.
translation: Cu 3 obiecte la 0,1 s, fiecare obiect se schimba cam la 0,3 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: When one finishes, the others speed up. Server delays can slow them down.
translation: Cand unul termina, celelalte accelereaza. Intarzierile serverului le pot incetini.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Close, X or Esc hide BS without stopping rerolling. With BS open, hits produce neither PM nor minimap notifications.
translation: Inchide, X sau Esc ascund BS fara sa opreasca rerularea. Cu BS deschis, reusitele nu dau nici PM, nici notificari pe minimapa.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: PM mode hides the status panel by the minimap. Popup and Popup + PM show the counters and speed.
translation: Modul PM ascunde panoul de stare de langa minimapa. Pop-up si Pop-up + PM arata contoarele si viteza.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start / Stop in the minimap status panel controls all BS slots. Open BS window shows the full window. The notification type is shared by accounts using this client folder.
translation: Start / Stop din panoul de stare al minimapei controleaza toate sloturile BS. Deschide fereastra BS arata fereastra intreaga. Tipul notificarii e comun conturilor care folosesc acest folder de client.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Choose Popup, PM or Popup + PM next to Presets. Hit notifications work only in the background. PM briefly pauses rerolls until its quest ends.
translation: Alege Pop-up, PM sau Pop-up + PM langa Presetari. Notificarile de reusita merg doar in fundal. PM opreste scurt rerularea pana se termina misiunea ei.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

translation: 7. Confirmari de la server si pauze
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits for a change to be confirmed before it sends the next request.
translation: BS asteapta confirmarea unei schimbari inainte sa trimita urmatoarea cerere.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits up to 5 s for confirmation, then retries after about 1 s. Three consecutive unconfirmed attempts stop the slot.
translation: BS asteapta pana la 5 s confirmarea, apoi reincearca dupa aproximativ 1 s. Trei incercari neconfirmate la rand opresc slotul.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Trade, storage, shops and NPC dialogs pause BS until the blocking window closes. After death, BS waits for revival.
translation: Negotul, depozitul, magazinele si dialogurile NPC opresc BS pana se inchide fereastra care blocheaza. Dupa moarte BS asteapta reinvierea.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A manual stop is never resumed by itself.
translation: O oprire manuala nu se reia niciodata singura.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 8. Teleports, channels and where the item is
translation: 8. Teleportari, canale si unde e obiectul
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: You can change the channel while rerolling. After a channel change or a teleport BS resumes after 5 s.
translation: Poti schimba canalul in timpul rerularii. Dupa schimbarea canalului sau o teleportare BS reia dupa 5 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: It resumes only if the item is still in the remembered inventory slot.
translation: Reia doar daca obiectul e inca in slotul de inventar retinut.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Picking up the item pauses BS. Returning it to the same cell resumes work without resetting the counter.
translation: Ridicarea obiectului opreste BS. Punerea lui inapoi in aceeasi celula reia lucrul fara resetarea contorului.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Moving stops BS. Right-click the same item in EQ to assign it again. You can also drag it onto its BS slot or return it to its previous EQ slot; then click Start.
translation: Mutarea opreste BS. Da clic dreapta pe acelasi obiect in EQ ca sa il atribui din nou. Il poti trage si pe slotul lui BS sau il poti pune inapoi in slotul vechi din EQ; apoi apasa Start.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 9. Buying reroll scrolls in the ItemShop
translation: 9. Cumpararea pergamentelor de rerulare din ItemShop
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS buys 200 scrolls for DC when fewer than 200 remain. It buys while rerolling or processing a manual change.
translation: BS cumpara 200 de pergamente pe DC cand raman mai putin de 200. Cumpara in timpul rerularii sau al unei schimbari manuale.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Switching it on asks for your consent and shows the price. It applies to this character only.
translation: Activarea iti cere acordul si arata pretul. Se aplica doar acestui personaj.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A purchase needs free inventory space. If another window blocks it, BS retries every 5 s.
translation: O cumparare are nevoie de loc liber in inventar. Daca o alta fereastra o blocheaza, BS reincearca la fiecare 5 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Missing Dragon Coins, or a purchase that left no scrolls in the inventory, stops BS.
translation: Lipsa Monedelor Dragon sau o cumparare care nu a lasat pergamente in inventar opresc BS.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Save preset stores both sets, the chosen bonuses and their values under a name.
translation: Salveaza presetarea stocheaza ambele seturi, bonusurile alese si valorile lor sub un nume.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Each category has its own presets: PvP can be saved separately for weapons and shoes.
translation: Fiecare categorie are presetarile ei: PvP poate fi salvat separat pentru arme si pantofi.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Bonus catalog: choose a category card with an icon to view its bonuses and possible values.
translation: Catalog de bonusuri: alege un card de categorie cu iconita ca sa vezi bonusurile si valorile posibile.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Compatible replacements keep targets. Another matching item needs Start. Restarting clears slots; named presets remain.
translation: Inlocuirile compatibile pastreaza tintele. Un alt obiect potrivit are nevoie de Start. Repornirea goleste sloturile; presetarile cu nume raman.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Presets can load before bonuses exist; Start checks targets. In the selection window, right-click adds to a free slot; dragging replaces a taken one.
translation: Presetarile se pot incarca inainte sa existe bonusuri; Start verifica tintele. In fereastra de selectie, clic dreapta adauga intr-un slot liber; tragerea inlocuieste unul ocupat.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Replacing selected bonuses, overwriting and deleting presets require confirmation. Presets are shared and synchronized between clients using the same folder.
translation: Inlocuirea bonusurilor alese, suprascrierea si stergerea presetarilor cer confirmare. Presetarile sunt comune si sincronizate intre clientii din acelasi folder.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A chosen bonus gets its maximum value; you can type your own.
translation: Un bonus ales primeste valoarea maxima; o poti scrie pe a ta.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Ordinary bonuses and values are green, maximum values gold, negative ones red.
translation: Bonusurile si valorile obisnuite sunt verzi, valorile maxime aurii, cele negative rosii.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Green in BS and inventory means the targets were reached. Red and yellow cover the full item size (1-3 cells).
translation: Verde in BS si in inventar inseamna ca tintele au fost atinse. Rosu si galben acopera toata marimea obiectului (1-3 celule).
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A selected tab has white text and border; inactive sets keep a red background. Counters total usage and purchases.
translation: O fila aleasa are text si chenar albe; seturile inactive pastreaza fundal rosu. Contoarele insumeaza utilizarea si cumpararile.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A right click on the item icon in BS works like Clear: the slot and its targets go.
translation: Un clic dreapta pe iconita obiectului din BS functioneaza ca Sterge: slotul si tintele lui dispar.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Clear all clears every slot, the used-scroll counter and notifications. Clear dismisses the notification for that slot.
translation: Sterge tot goleste fiecare slot, contorul de pergamente folosite si notificarile. Sterge elimina notificarea acelui slot.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Presets and inventory items remain after clearing. Full slots also show a popup; identical matches need dragging.
translation: Presetarile si obiectele din inventar raman dupa golire. Sloturile pline arata si un pop-up; potrivirile identice trebuie trase.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Changing targets or restarting a slot dismisses its previous notification.
translation: Schimbarea tintelor sau repornirea unui slot elimina notificarea anterioara.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Red marks the selected item. Yellow with its BS slot number marks the original cell. Closing Info resets the page.
translation: Rosul marcheaza obiectul ales. Galbenul cu numarul slotului BS marcheaza celula originala. Inchiderea Info reseteaza pagina.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
